name: JUDAH
canonical: Judah, a rugged young Hebrew shepherd-son of about thirty, sun-bronzed skin and a thick dark beard, a strong-jawed weather-worn face with hard calculating eyes, wearing a coarse striped wool tunic girded with a leather belt and a rough goat-hair shoulder-cloak, a shepherd's crook in his calloused hand
